title: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification across Molecular Foundation Models for Small-Sample Regression
description: Code, configurations, results, figures, and the manuscript for a split-conformal prediction-interval-quality benchmark (coverage and width) across modern molecular foundation models (MolFormer-XL, ChemFM-3B, Uni-Mol, TabPFN) alongside traditional QSAR and a D-MPNN, on six small-sample regression datasets.
